content:
Daloopa inflection workflow: find where a company's trajectory actually changed, not where the narrative says it did.
1. Pull daloopa_company_fundamentals and daloopa_kpi_metrics across all covered quarters for one ticker.
2. Compute quarter-over-quarter growth per series first, then year-over-year growth for the same series.
3. Flag growth-rate reversals as inflections - a series that was accelerating and starts decelerating, or the reverse.
4. Distinguish one-quarter noise from a turn: an inflection needs the new direction to hold for more than a single print.
5. Tie each flagged inflection to the KPI that moved first; drivers usually lead, revenue usually confirms.
6. Cite the underlying inputs via source_url for every flagged move.
description: Detect metric accelerations and decelerations across quarters.
name: Daloopa Inflection
